author: David Wilson
title: Mayor 'Caves' Amid Trump's National Emergency Threat - NewsBreak
text:
By David Wilson ,
49 minutes ago President Donald Trump has threatened to declare another national emergency and place Washington, D.C., under federal control after Mayor Muriel Bowser ended the Metropolitan Police Department’s cooperation with federal immigration enforcement. Trump argued that federal oversight strengthens public safety, citing improvements in his latest intervention. Bowser countered that MPD should focus on local policing, not immigration duties.
Bowser opted not to challenge Trump’s threatened national emergency declaration over the city’s refusal to cooperate with ICE on sharing information about undocumented immigrants. Critics have framed Bowser as “caving” to federal pressure.
The Bowser administration said that after the 30-day emergency, MPD will assist immigration agents only under limited D.C. law exceptions. During the emergency, federal authorities directed MPD assistance.
Bowser said, “Immigration enforcement is not what MPD does.” She added, “And with the end of the emergency, it won’t be what MPD does in the future.”
Trump argued the intervention significantly reduced crime and warned rates could rise without MPD support for ICE. He suggested he may federalize D.C. again to ensure cooperation.
Trump wrote, “The Federal Government, under my auspices as President of the United States of America, has stepped into the complete criminal mess that was Washington, D.C., our Nation’s Capital.”
Trump added, “Because of this, D.C. has gone from one of the most dangerous and murder ridden cities in the U.S.A., and even around the World, to one of the safest – In just a few weeks. The ‘place’ is absolutely booming, with restaurants, stores, and businesses packed and, for the first time in decades, virtually NO CRIME.”
Bowser emphasized continuity in public safety, stating the city will maintain strategies behind recent crime declines. She noted ending the emergency restores standard separation between policing and immigration enforcement.
Bowser said, “The things that were against the law last month are still against the law. We still don’t want people using guns in our community. We don’t want anybody stealing from stores and from each other in our community. Carjacking will not be tolerated in our communities.”
ICE operations have continued in D.C. without routine MPD assistance. MPD has reverted to its standard legal limits, but would see a shift if Trump implements further federalization.
Trump wrote, “Under pressure from the Radical Left Democrats, Mayor Muriel Bowser, who has presided over this violent criminal takeover of our Capital for years, has informed the Federal Government that the Metropolitan Police Department will no longer cooperate with ICE in removing and relocating dangerous illegal aliens.”
Trump concluded, “If I allowed this to happen, CRIME would come roaring back. To the people and businesses of Washington, D.C., DON’T WORRY, I AM WITH YOU, AND WON’T ALLOW THIS TO HAPPEN. I’ll call a National Emergency, and Federalize, if necessary!!!”
David Wilson covers U.S. politics & news for content partner Modern Newsstand LLC.
